from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BorrowingCashItem(BaseModel):
    """One company's 'cash received from borrowing' amount from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as written in the document")
    borrowing_cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The 'cash received from borrowing' amount, numerically extracted")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    statement_section: str | None = Field(description="The financial statement section where the amount appears, e.g. '合并现金流量表筹资活动'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    borrowing_cash_items: list[BorrowingCashItem]
